name: linkedin-mcp-server
description: MCP server that gives Claude access to LinkedIn profiles, companies, job details, and people search through your own account
long_description:
# MCP Server for LinkedIn

> Disclaimer: This is an independent, community project. It is not affiliated with, authorized by, endorsed by, or sponsored by LinkedIn Corporation or Microsoft. "LinkedIn" is a registered trademark of LinkedIn Corporation and is used here only descriptively to identify the third-party service this software interoperates with.

Connect Claude to your LinkedIn account with an MCP Bundle (MCPB, formerly DXT). The bundle starts quickly, downloads the Patchright Chromium browser in the background when needed, and opens LinkedIn login on the first auth-requiring tool call.

## First-time managed runtime flow

1. Install the `.mcpb` bundle in Claude Desktop.
2. Start Claude Desktop; the MCP server starts and begins preparing the Patchright Chromium browser cache under `~/.linkedin-mcp/patchright-browsers`.
3. If you call a tool before setup finishes, the tool returns a setup-in-progress error.
4. On the first tool call that needs authentication, a browser window opens so you can sign into LinkedIn.
5. Retry the tool after login completes.

Docker remains available as a separate runtime path, but it still requires host-side `--login`.

tools.name: get_person_profile
tools.description: Get detailed information from a LinkedIn profile including work history, education, certifications, skills, projects, connections, and recent posts

tools.name: get_my_profile
tools.description: Get the authenticated user's own LinkedIn profile with optional section selection (experience, education, skills, etc.)

tools.name: connect_with_person
tools.description: Send a connection request or accept an incoming one, with optional note and explicit confirmation; confirm=false returns a browser-free preview

tools.name: get_sidebar_profiles
tools.description: Extract profile URLs from LinkedIn sidebar recommendation sections on a profile page

tools.name: get_company_profile
tools.description: Extract comprehensive company information and details. About-section references may include a company_urn entry carrying the numeric id LinkedIn's people-search uses in its currentCompany URL facet.

tools.name: get_company_posts
tools.description: Get recent posts from a company's LinkedIn feed

tools.name: search_companies
tools.description: Search for companies on LinkedIn by keywords, paginating up to max_pages and reporting pages_fetched/stopped_reason/truncated

tools.name: get_company_employees
tools.description: List employees at a company from the LinkedIn /people/ page, with optional keyword filter by name, title, or skill

tools.name: get_job_details
tools.description: Retrieve specific job posting details using LinkedIn job IDs

tools.name: search_jobs
tools.description: Search for jobs with filters like keywords and location; reports LinkedIn's own advertised result total when available

tools.name: get_saved_jobs
tools.description: List job postings saved by the authenticated LinkedIn user

tools.name: save_job
tools.description: Save or unsave a LinkedIn job posting for the authenticated account, with explicit confirmation; idempotent

tools.name: get_job_alerts
tools.description: List the authenticated LinkedIn user's job alerts, with each alert's own search returned as a reference

tools.name: search_people
tools.description: Search for people on LinkedIn by keywords, location (free text, resolved at call time, or a numeric geo URN id), connection degree (1st/2nd/3rd), current/past company, school, industry, title, and profile language, paginating up to max_pages and reporting pages_fetched/stopped_reason/truncated

tools.name: resolve_geo_location
tools.description: Resolve a free-text place name to LinkedIn geo URN id candidates via LinkedIn's own location typeahead, without running a search

tools.name: get_inbox
tools.description: List recent conversations from the LinkedIn messaging inbox

tools.name: get_conversation
tools.description: Read a specific messaging conversation by thread ID or LinkedIn username

tools.name: search_conversations
tools.description: Search LinkedIn messages by keyword

tools.name: send_message
tools.description: Compose and send a new single-line message without C0 or DEL control characters (including CR, LF, and tab) to a LinkedIn user with explicit confirmation and optional profile URN support; profile-based targeting may create a separate DM instead of replying in an existing thread, and when no normal Message action is exposed, use connect_with_person and retry after acceptance

tools.name: reply_to_conversation
tools.description: Reply within an existing LinkedIn messaging thread (recruiter/InMail/DM) by thread ID, with explicit confirmation

tools.name: mark_conversation_read
tools.description: Mark a LinkedIn conversation thread as read or unread via its options menu, with explicit confirmation; idempotent

tools.name: archive_conversation
tools.description: Archive or unarchive a LinkedIn conversation thread via its options menu, with explicit confirmation; idempotent

tools.name: get_feed
tools.description: Get recent posts from the authenticated user's LinkedIn home feed

tools.name: get_notifications
tools.description: List recent notifications (replies, reactions, mentions, connection requests) from the LinkedIn notifications page, with an optional 'my_posts'/'mentions' filter

tools.name: get_hashtag_feed
tools.description: Get recent posts from a LinkedIn hashtag feed (/feed/hashtag/<tag>/)

tools.name: search_posts
tools.description: Search LinkedIn posts/content globally by keyword (the 'Posts' tab) with an optional recency filter (past-24h/past-week/past-month) and sort order (relevance/latest), reporting stopped_reason/truncated

tools.name: get_post_comments
tools.description: Read a LinkedIn post's comments and replies with each comment's URN, parent comment, author, permalink and excerpt

tools.name: reply_to_comment
tools.description: Reply to one comment on a LinkedIn post, located by its URN, with explicit confirmation; the reply is confirmed on the page and @mentions are not supported

tools.name: comment_on_post
tools.description: Post a top-level comment on a LinkedIn post with explicit confirmation; the comment is confirmed on the page and @mentions are not supported

tools.name: react_to_comment
tools.description: Like one comment on a LinkedIn post, located by its URN, with explicit confirmation

tools.name: create_post
tools.description: Publish or schedule a LinkedIn post with explicit confirmation: real @mentions resolved by profile/company URL or URN (fails closed when no suggestion matches), up to 20 images or one PDF/PPTX/DOCX document carousel with a title, visibility, posting as an administered company page (post_as: EXPERIMENTAL, not fully tested, disabled unless ENABLE_COMPANY_PAGE_TOOLS=true), and LinkedIn-native scheduling; confirm=false returns a browser-free preview

tools.name: create_poll
tools.description: Publish or schedule a LinkedIn poll with explicit confirmation: question up to 140 characters, 2-4 distinct options up to 30 characters, 1/3/7/14-day duration, optional text with mentions, post_as (EXPERIMENTAL, disabled unless ENABLE_COMPANY_PAGE_TOOLS=true) and schedule_at; confirm=false returns a browser-free preview

tools.name: get_scheduled_posts
tools.description: List the authenticated user's scheduled LinkedIn posts with identifiers for delete_scheduled_post

tools.name: edit_scheduled_post
tools.description: Change a scheduled LinkedIn post's text and/or scheduled time by its get_scheduled_posts identifier, with explicit confirmation

tools.name: delete_scheduled_post
tools.description: Delete one scheduled LinkedIn post by the identifier get_scheduled_posts returned, with explicit confirmation

tools.name: edit_post
tools.description: Replace the text of the authenticated user's own published LinkedIn post after verifying authorship, with explicit confirmation; LinkedIn re-evaluates distribution on edits

tools.name: delete_post
tools.description: Delete the authenticated user's own published LinkedIn post after verifying authorship, with explicit confirmation

tools.name: get_mutual_connections
tools.description: List LinkedIn connections shared between the authenticated user and another profile, reached via the profile's own shared-connections search link

tools.name: list_connections
tools.description: List the authenticated user's 1st-degree connections, sorted by recently-added, first name, or last name

tools.name: get_invitations
tools.description: List outgoing or incoming LinkedIn connection-request invitations

tools.name: withdraw_invitation
tools.description: Withdraw a previously-sent, still-pending connection request, identified by profile URL

tools.name: respond_to_invitation
tools.description: Accept or ignore an incoming connection request, identified by profile URL

tools.name: follow
tools.description: Follow or unfollow a LinkedIn person or company page with explicit confirmation; nothing is clicked when the page is already in the requested state

tools.name: search_groups
tools.description: Search for LinkedIn groups by keyword

tools.name: get_group_posts
tools.description: List recent posts from a LinkedIn group's home feed

tools.name: get_group_members
tools.description: List members of a LinkedIn group from its /members/ page; the full list requires the authenticated account to be a member of the group

tools.name: get_saved_posts
tools.description: List posts saved by the authenticated LinkedIn user

tools.name: search_events
tools.description: Search for LinkedIn events by keyword

tools.name: get_event_details
tools.description: Get the details page for a single LinkedIn event

tools.name: get_event_attendees
tools.description: List attendees of a LinkedIn event, with a bounded scroll budget

tools.name: get_post_analytics
tools.description: Read the analytics of one of the signed-in member's own LinkedIn posts: impressions, reach, engagement, profile viewers, followers gained and audience demographics

tools.name: get_profile_analytics
tools.description: Read the signed-in member's own profile and creator analytics dashboards: profile viewers, search appearances, followers and post impressions

tools.name: sales_nav_search_leads
tools.description: Search Sales Navigator leads (people) by keyword and optional filters. Requires a Sales Navigator seat; returns a clear error when the account does not have one.

tools.name: sales_nav_search_accounts
tools.description: Search Sales Navigator accounts (companies) by keyword and optional filters. Requires a Sales Navigator seat; returns a clear error when the account does not have one.

tools.name: sales_nav_get_lists
tools.description: List the authenticated user's Sales Navigator lead or account lists. Requires a Sales Navigator seat.

tools.name: sales_nav_get_list
tools.description: Read one Sales Navigator list's members, bounded by max_items. Requires a Sales Navigator seat.

tools.name: save_post
tools.description: Save or unsave a LinkedIn post via its overflow menu's toggle, identified structurally; requires confirmation

tools.name: get_post_reactions
tools.description: List who reacted to a LinkedIn post by opening its reactions dialog (structural probe); reaction type is not extracted

tools.name: close_session
tools.description: Properly close browser session and clean up resources

tools.name: get_pacing_status
tools.description: Show LinkedIn pacing counters, when the next read and write are allowed, any cooldown, and the effective limits, without contacting LinkedIn

proxy_server.title: Proxy server
proxy_server.description: Optional. Route the browser through a proxy, as scheme://host:port (http, https, socks4 or socks5). May also include credentials, as http://user:password@host:port. Only browser traffic is routed.

proxy_username.title: Proxy username
proxy_username.description: Optional. Username for the proxy, if it requires one.

proxy_password.title: Proxy password
proxy_password.description: Optional. Password for the proxy. Chromium cannot authenticate to a SOCKS proxy, so credentials require an http or https endpoint.

proxy_bypass.title: Proxy bypass list
proxy_bypass.description: Optional. Comma-separated hosts to reach directly instead of through the proxy.
